# Director of Operations

Company: Acme Care
Location: Remote, United States
Requisition ID: ACME-2048
Salary: $145,000-$165,000

Acme Care is hiring a Director of Operations to lead multi-site healthcare
operations. The role manages a team of 20, owns a $10 million operating
budget, improves patient access, negotiates vendor contracts, and presents
operating results to executives.

Required:

- Seven or more years of operations experience
- Three or more years managing people
- Multi-site healthcare experience
- Budget ownership
- Vendor management

Preferred:

- Experience managing teams of 15 or more
- Direct ownership of a budget above $5 million
